h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Alappuzha

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Alappuzha

c: Salt air, backwater humidity and one of the heaviest monsoons in India all act on any equipment left outdoors in Alappuzha. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier for Alappuzha's beachside promenades, municipal parks, resorts, schools and housing projects. We make the Fun Fitness range at our factory in Vasai, about 1,160 km away, and deliver it by road to the Kerala coast.

Near the sea, corrosion is the main thing to plan for. Our frames are galvanised steel pipe, where the zinc coating protects the steel, and seats, handles and footplates are roto-moulded plastic that cannot rust. Even so, a quick rinse with fresh water every few weeks removes salt deposits and keeps the moving parts free. Resorts along the backwaters often want a small fitness corner for guests that looks tidy beside the garden. Tell us the theme colours of the property and we can match them from our colour shades.

items.q: How do we look after outdoor gym equipment near the sea?
items.a: Rinse the machines with fresh water every few weeks, check the moving joints, and follow the maintenance steps we give you at handover. This slows salt build-up on the galvanised frames.

items.q: Can you install on soft or sandy coastal ground?
items.a: Yes, usually by grouting each post into a concrete base. Loose sand is not firm enough for self-standing machines. We confirm the method after seeing your site.

items.q: Do you supply resorts in Kerala?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch from Vasai by road and install through our team or a dealer in the south. Share your site plan and theme colours, and we will send a layout and quote.
